description: First floor and two storey side extension; Single storey side to rear extension; Alterations to roof to form side dormer, Roof lights in front and rear roof slopes; Solar panels to side and rear roof slopes; External alterations
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">15DR-PL-00, 15DR-PL-01, 15DR-PL-02,
15DR-PL-03, 15DR-PL-04, 15DR-PL-05, 15DR-PL-06, 15DR-PL-07, 15DR-PL-08, 15DR-PL-09,
15DR-PL-10, Site Location Plan, FIRE SAFETY STATEMENT (10/11/25), </span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Flood Risk Assessment - 15 Devonshire
Road, Pinner, Harrow HA5 4LY (1501/2026), Appendix E Harrow Council's Surface
Water Flood Maps, Appendix G Proposed Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS), Appendix
F Compensatory Flood Storage (CFS), Appendix D Environment Agency's Flood Maps</span><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;tab-stops:1.0cm;

The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority, detailed drawings of all underground works, including those to be carried out by statutory undertakers, in connection with the provision of services to, and within, the site in relation to the protected trees to be retained in close proximity to the site.

<p>The window in the side elevation of the proposed development shall:
</p><p>(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
</p><p>(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>
